title: A Comparative Analysis of Transformer Models for Abstractive Summarization of Indian Legal Judgments
venue: 1st International Conference on Machine Intelligence and Data Science (MIDAS 2025), Springer. Paralakhemundi, Odisha, India.
abstract: A comparative study of transformer architectures for abstractive summarization of long-form Indian legal judgments, which routinely exceed the context windows these models were trained for. Evaluates the candidates on a domain-specific benchmark and proposes a fine-tuning strategy for the legal-judgment setting.

title: Data-Driven Analysis of Siddha Naadi Prediction System
abstract: Applies machine learning to model pulse-based diagnostic patterns from the Siddha Naadi tradition, connecting a classical diagnostic practice to computational prediction methods.
